links.outcome: Algorithmic fairness of ML models predicting childhood mental health problems across subgroups
links.effect: Fairness assessments showed potential biases within the models; best SVM model AUROC 0.743 (95% CI 0.724-0.762). No subgroup numbers given in the text.
links.quote: Assessments of algorithmic fairness showed potential biases within these models.

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates predictive machine learning models for childhood mental health problems using administrative data, including assessments of algorithmic fairness and interpretability, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or workflow.
